fields.name: activity_id
fields.short: If specified, this activity will be converted into a call log, with the information provided.

fields.name: company_id
fields.short: The company ID of the owner of the call log

fields.name: deal_id
fields.short: The ID of the deal this call is associated with.

fields.name: duration
fields.short: The duration of the call in seconds

fields.name: end_time
fields.short: The date and time of the end of the call in UTC.

fields.name: from_phone_number
fields.short: The number that made the call

fields.name: has_recording
fields.short: If the call log has an audio recording attached, the value should be true

fields.name: id
fields.short: The call log ID, generated when the call log was created

fields.name: lead_id
fields.short: The ID of the lead in the UUID format this call is associated with.

fields.name: note
fields.short: The note for the call log in HTML format

fields.name: org_id
fields.short: The ID of the organization this call is associated with

fields.name: outcome
fields.short: Describes the outcome of the call

fields.name: person_id
fields.short: The ID of the person this call is associated with

fields.name: start_time
fields.short: The date and time of the start of the call in UTC.

fields.name: subject
fields.short: The name of the activity this call is attached to

fields.name: to_phone_number
fields.short: The number called

fields.name: user_id
fields.short: The ID of the owner of the call log.

contract.json: {"operationId":"addFilter","parameters":[{"description":"If set to `true`, each condition in the response includes a `field_code` field identifying the field by its code name","in":"query","name":"include_field_code","required":false,"schema":{"type":"boolean"}}],"protocol":"http","requestBody":{"content":{"application/json":{"schema":{"properties":{"conditions":{"description":"The conditions of the filter as a JSON object. Please note that a maximum of 16 conditions is allowed per filter and `date` values must be supplied in the `YYYY-MM-DD` format. It requires a minimum structure as follows: `{\"glue\":\"and\",\"conditions\":[{\"glue\":\"and\",\"conditions\": [CONDITION_OBJECTS]},{\"glue\":\"or\",\"conditions\":[CONDITION_OBJECTS]}]}`. Replace `CONDITION_OBJECTS` with JSON objects of the following structure: `{\"object\":\"\",\"field_id\":\"\", \"operator\":\"\",\"value\":\"\", \"extra_value\":\"\"}` or leave the array empty. fields.name: add_time
fields.short: The date and time of when the lead was created.

fields.name: cc_email
fields.short: The BCC email of the lead

fields.name: channel
fields.short: The ID of your Marketing channel this Lead was created from.

fields.name: channel_id
fields.short: The optional ID to further distinguish the Marketing channel.

fields.name: creator_id
fields.short: The ID of the user who created the lead

fields.name: expected_close_date
fields.short: The date of when the deal which will be created from the lead is expected to be closed.

fields.name: id
fields.short: The unique ID of the lead in the UUID format

fields.name: is_archived
fields.short: A flag indicating whether the lead is archived or not

fields.name: label_ids
fields.short: The IDs of the lead labels which are associated with the lead

fields.name: next_activity_id
fields.short: The ID of the next activity associated with the lead

fields.name: organization_id
fields.short: The ID of an organization which this lead is linked to

fields.name: origin
fields.short: The way this Lead was created.

fields.name: origin_id
fields.short: The optional ID to further distinguish the origin of the lead - e.g.

fields.name: owner_id
fields.short: The ID of the user who owns the lead

fields.name: person_id
fields.short: The ID of a person which this lead is linked to

fields.name: source_deal_id
fields.short: The ID of the deal if the lead was converted from a deal.

fields.name: source_name
fields.short: Defines where the lead comes from.

fields.name: title
fields.short: The title of the lead

fields.name: update_time
fields.short: The date and time of when the lead was last updated.

fields.name: value
fields.short: The potential value of the lead represented by a JSON object: `{ "amount": 200, "currency": "EUR" }`.

fields.name: visible_to
fields.short: The visibility of the lead.

fields.name: was_seen
fields.short: A flag indicating whether the lead was seen by someone in the Pipedrive UI
